buildCommand: cd web && npm install && npm run build

rewrites.comment: Send API calls to wherever the indexer runs (EC2, Render, Fly). Set INDEXER_ORIGIN and replace this host, or delete this rule to run without an indexer: the site then reads the chain directly and only the perk gate is unavailable.
Single-page app: every other route serves index.html so /badge/9 works on a hard refresh.
